summary: Iteration 41: tested F5/F6 global voucher shortcuts, global Ctrl+S fallback, and the new Rokad Invoice No. (inv_no) field end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass. Frontend: everything requested works, with ONE bug: pressing Ctrl+S inside the 'Naya Party Khata' child window (opened from the Rokad form) submits the PARENT Rokad form, not the party form.

ui_bugs.issue: Ctrl+S with focus inside 'Naya Party Khata (entry ke liye)' (modal-party, z-[60], opened by typing a new party name in the Rokad form + Enter) submits the Rokad form instead of the khata form. Result: POST /rokad saved with an UNLINKED party (party_id='', party_name='TEST_ZZQ41 NEW'), the Rokad modal closes, and the khata window is left open by itself. Reproduced. Cause: useGlobalSave picks the last '.fixed.inset-0' in DOM order. KhataModal is rendered at RokadPanna line ~503, BEFORE the Rokad modal (~670), so the Rokad overlay is 'last' even though KhataModal sits on top visually (z-60). The code also prefers the overlay's form over document.activeElement.closest('form').

Journal Ctrl+S → exactly 1 POST /journal (rows 0→1). Bill Ctrl+S on an empty form → only the bill's own validation ('Party select karein'), no POST. Staff modal: empty → no POST (HTML required); filled → exactly 1 POST /staff

Party ledger and cash-account ledger: badges V.1 / INV INV-77B; Statement shows 'PAYMENT PAID · CASH IN HAND · INV INV-77B' with VCH/REF = 1; Ledger Excel has an 'INV No.' column with the value
Regression: Esc closes the Rokad modal; keys a/r/p open the form (p = kharch, r = jama); Alt+D → /journal; the ? help lists F5/F6 under Universal shortcuts

action_items: Fix useGlobalSave target selection: first use document.activeElement?.closest('form') if it lies inside an open overlay. Otherwise choose the overlay with the highest computed z-index, or render KhataModal after the Rokad modal. Retest: Rokad form → type a new party name → Enter → in modal-party press Ctrl+S → the khata should save, not the rokad entry.
critical_code_review_comments: useGlobalSave: selecting overlays with '.fixed.inset-0' in DOM order is fragile for stacked modals (see the bug above). It is also coupled to Tailwind class names.

voucherOpen: F5/F6 on /rokad while ANOTHER /rokad overlay is open (Voucher Slip, KhataModal, Transfer) still navigates and opens/switches the Rokad form underneath. Low risk but inconsistent with the data-safety rule.
F5 while editing an existing entry on /rokad only changes the type and keeps editId. Probably intended, but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 bug: Ctrl+S in the stacked create-party modal)

Typing a new party name + Enter in the Rokad form opens modal-party. Excel files can be saved from Playwright to /tmp and parsed locally with openpyxl.
rca of the issue: Repro: /rokad → 'a' → amount 7 → type a new party name in select-party → Enter → modal-party opens → click an input in it → Ctrl+S → POST /rokad fires ('Entry add ki gayi'), modal-add-rokad closes, modal-party stays open. RCA: useGlobalSave uses overlays[overlays.length-1], which is DOM order, not stacking order, and ignores the focused element's form.
